_comment: TradeForge language catalogue — ENGLISH. Keys are stable identifiers, mirroring lang/hu.json (the base catalogue). Never invent a key here: a key that does not exist in hu.json is dead weight, and the test (tests/test_i18n.py) fails on it. The {name} placeholders must match hu.json exactly.
_comment_terms: Trading terms stay untranslated on purpose: spread, ATR, PF, MaxDD, WPR, SMA, BE, trailing, Risky, Fibo.

gate.display_only:
This column SHOWS, it does not decide — it has no adjustable effect.
The filtering happens in the strategy's entry gate (atr_min_pct / atr_max_pct, under the Market filter category).
Set it there, not here: that way the backtest, the visualisation and live trading all filter the same way.

bt.cal_from: Pick the start date from a calendar.
bt.cal_to: Pick the end date from a calendar.
bt.hours_only: Trading hours only (trade_hours, as in live)
bt.exec_gates: Realistic execution gates (TF alignment + spread, as in live)
bt.slots_tip:
Number of slots that can be open at once — it sets the POSITION SIZE,
not the number of positions (one pair runs one trade anyway).
The risk is split across this many slots:
more slots = smaller lot. The default comes from
trading.max_open_slots in the config.
bt.initial_tip:
The backtest's starting capital ($). It scales the position size
(risk = balance × account_risk_pct) and the
percentage return. Empty = the config's
starting balance (starting_balance_eur).
bt.params_on_tab: The parameters live on the Parameters tab — the run uses the values entered there. (If you change them there, this tab refreshes itself.)
bt.preset_tip: Off = base handling (BE + trailing). Risky = halved size + immediate BE at 1R. Halving/Shield = close 50%/75% at 1R + runner. Fibo = stop to BE at 61.8% of the entry→TP distance (no partial close/trailing). Thirds = 1/3–2/3: after the base distance (1R) the stop goes to 1/3, at the target to 2/3. Shield↔Fibo = auto: Fibo on a big move, otherwise Shield (decided at entry).
bt.cautious_tip: Halved entry size. Risky always halves it; with Halving/Shield it can be switched on as extra caution.
bt.runner_tip: The stop of the piece left AFTER Halving/Shield's partial close (runner): Trailing / Stays away / BE / Exit signal.
bt.costcut_tip: Time stop: if the position is still losing after this many main bars (M15), we close it at market. Combines with any preset.
bt.exit_tip: Which indicator closes the remainder: Supertrend flip / WPR cross-back / Divergence.
bt.build_tip: Off / Manual / Auto. Auto: models it with any preset (it also builds on the risk-free runner, as in live). Manual: ONLY with an R-based trigger (deterministic) — candle-based Manual is a user click, we do not model that. A built package has no TP: it runs to the average-price stop / exit signal (as in live).
bt.factor_tip: Pyramid size multiplier: each add-on = previous × Factor (HOW MUCH).
bt.trigger_tip: Candle = trend following. Fixed R = +1R,+2R… (constant step). R-halving = the step shrinks → they get denser.
bt.rshrink_tip: The step's multiplier per add-on (0.5 = halving; 2/3; 3/4…).
bt.rr_note: (exploratory — not saved; in Auto mode Building is modelled with ANY preset (on the risk-free runner too, as in live), in Manual only with an R-based trigger. Only the original rr result is written back to the main screen.)
bt.build_csv_tip: The position building (add-on) rows ITEM BY ITEM for Excel: one row = one built trade, broken down by legs (pyramid), and HOW MUCH the add-on contributed in R and $. Only active if the run had add-ons (Building ≠ Off). ⚠ This is NOT the optimisation result — that is on the Trials tab (trials CSV).
bt.params_reset: Parameters restored to the values from when this opened.
bt.applied: The parameters were written back into the Strategy Parameters form (the Save button persists them).
bt.running: Backtest running… (the Cancel button stops it)
bt.series_reused: Candidate list: reused ({n} signals) — only the execution changed, the entry signals are identical
bt.series_recalc: Candidate list: recalculated ({n} signals) — the signal side (or the period/hour filter) changed
bt.done_written: Done — the result was written to the main screen.
bt.done_explore: Done (exploratory rr — not written back to the main screen).
bt.no_build_csv: No Building CSV — this run had no add-ons.
bt.build_none: Building: 0 add-ons — no build signal fired (in Manual mode only an R-based trigger can be modelled).
bt.build_line: Building: {adds} add-ons on {trades} trades  ·  the built trades: {pkg}$ / {pkgr} R ({per} R/trade)  ·  of which the add-ons: {pnl}$ / {r} R   (itemised: Building CSV)
bt.no_curve: not enough data for the curve
exit.tip.st_multiplier: Supertrend ATR multiplier — bigger = looser band, closes later.
exit.tip.wpr_ma_period: The period of the WPR's moving average (what it crosses).
exit.tip.osc: Oscillator for the divergence: rsi or cci.
exit.tip.div_pivot: Pivot width — how many bars confirm the high/low.
